title: pi-claude-agent-sdk
brief: An inference provider that lets Pi (a terminal agent harness) run on Claude Code Pro/Max subscriptions instead of API keys. Kenn is using a fork and admits he "just closed my eyes and let the agent figure it out" — expect rough edges.
caveat: Kenn is using a fork and admits he "just closed my eyes and let the agent figure it out" — expect rough edges.
details: A Pi extension that runs Claude models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku — including Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5) inside the Pi coding agent via Anthropic's Agent SDK, billed against your existing Claude Pro/Max subscription quota rather than API spend. Install with `pi install npm:pi-claude-agent-sdk`, then pick any Claude model in `/model`. Behind the scenes it bridges Pi's tools into Claude Code while keeping Pi's TUI, adding streaming, MCP tool bridging, custom tool bridging, session resume/persistence, context sync, thinking support, and skills forwarding. Newer models get 1M context; the model list auto-tracks Pi's Anthropic catalog, so new Claude models appear without a bridge update. The README is unusually honest about caveats: abort-heavy sessions cost noticeably more (session rebuilds re-send the whole conversation and lose prompt cache), exported `ANTHROPIC_*` environment variables redirect the child CLI and break auth, mid-session system-prompt changes may not take effect until a rebuild, and system-prompt edits that strip Pi's prompt refuse the turn to avoid Extra Usage billing. Fork lineage: pi-claude-bridge by Eli Dickinson, originally claude-agent-sdk-pi by Prateek Sunal. MIT.
